stories.title: El Niño's storm-killer winds and climate's warming waters in fight over future of Hurricane Isaias

en.title: El Niño's storm-killer winds and climate's warming waters in fight over future of Hurricane Isaias
en.summary: Hurricane Isaias approached the U.S. Gulf Coast on October 8, 2026, with atmospheric and oceanic conditions potentially influencing its trajectory and intensity.

stories.title: José Ramírez homers as the Guardians beat the White Sox 9-5 to force a decisive Game 5 in ALDS

en.title: José Ramírez homers as the Guardians beat the White Sox 9-5 to force a decisive Game 5 in ALDS
en.summary: Cleveland defeated Chicago 9-5 in Game 4 of the American League Division Series on October 8, 2026, with Ramírez hitting a two-run home run to extend the playoff series.

stories.title: U.S., Ukrainians and Europeans meeting to discuss ‘new ideas’ to end Russia-Ukraine war

en.title: U.S., Ukrainians and Europeans meeting to discuss 'new ideas' to end Russia-Ukraine war
en.summary: Officials from the U.S., Ukraine, and Europe held discussions to explore approaches for resolving the conflict, following previous negotiation rounds that produced limited results.

stories.title: Indigenous cultural burn near Osoyoos revives traditional fire stewardship

en.title: Indigenous cultural burn near Osoyoos revives traditional fire stewardship
en.summary: A controlled burn west of Osoyoos implemented Indigenous fire management practices to reduce wildfire risk while restoring traditional stewardship methods.

stories.title: Steven Galloway accuser threatened to sue UBC for up to $3-million, defamation trial hears

en.title: Steven Galloway accuser threatened to sue UBC for up to $3-million, defamation trial hears
en.summary: During a defamation trial, a court heard that a former UBC creative-writing student threatened legal action against the university for up to $3 million. The university had previously provided her with a $30,000 bursary that Galloway claimed she was not eligible to receive.

stories.title: Ex-Postmedia chair alleges Ford’s office used government contract as ‘leverage’ for an op-ed

en.title: Ex-Postmedia chair alleges Ford's office used government contract as 'leverage' for an op-ed
en.summary: A former Postmedia chairman claimed that Ontario's Premier's Office leveraged a government contract to influence the newspaper chain's editorial content. Both the Premier's Office and Postmedia have rejected this allegation.

stories.title: Consultants for Hydro-Québec defend proposal to double energy costs for data centres

en.title: Consultants for Hydro-Québec defend proposal to double energy costs for data centres
en.summary: Energy consultants from Dunsky presented arguments supporting Hydro-Québec's plan to double electricity rates for data centres at a public regulatory hearing reviewing the proposal.

stories.title: Yakemchuk scores winner as Sens edge Flyers 2-1

en.title: Yakemchuk scores winner as Sens edge Flyers 2-1
en.summary: Carter Yakemchuk scored his first goal of the season to secure a 2-1 victory for the Ottawa Senators against the Philadelphia Flyers on Thursday night.

stories.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers QB Zach Collaros intends to play on Saturday

en.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers QB Zach Collaros intends to play on Saturday
en.summary: Winnipeg Blue Bombers quarterback Zach Collaros has been listed as questionable for Saturday's game but expressed his intention to play in what the team considers their most important game of the season.

stories.title: Putin tells Iran’s president that Russia will ‘do everything’ to help end war with U.S., Israel

en.title: Putin tells Iran's president that Russia will 'do everything' to help end war with U.S., Israel
en.summary: Russia and Iran have strengthened their diplomatic and military ties since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, with the two nations increasingly dependent on one another.

stories.title: U.S. military to livestream firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter

en.title: U.S. military to livestream firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter
en.summary: The U.S. military will livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, who carried out a shooting at Fort Hood, Texas in 2009 that killed 13 people, marking the military's first firing squad execution since World War II.

stories.title: Pentagon says Fort Hood shooter’s execution will be livestreamed

en.title: Pentagon says Fort Hood shooter's execution will be livestreamed
en.summary: The Army announced that the execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed and is scheduled to take place at Fort Hood on December 3.

en.title: Alberta First Nation taking Ottawa to court over move to fast-track Pacific Link pipeline
en.summary: An Alberta First Nation has launched the first legal challenge against federal efforts to accelerate approval processes for the Pacific Link pipeline, which is a priority for both Ottawa and Alberta.

stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Digital-asset tracing will be key priority for new financial-crimes agency, deputy minister says
en.summary: A deputy minister indicates that a new financial-crimes agency will prioritize digital-asset tracing and will need to recruit staff with expertise in forensic accounting, digital forensics, and blockchain analysis.

en.summary: Infoway responded to a wrongful-dismissal lawsuit filed by former CEO Michael Green, who claims he was scapegoated for the failure of the PrescribeIT program.

en.summary: SpaceX is pursuing spectrum acquisition to enter the wireless carrier market, causing telecom shares to decline as investors worry about potential price competition.
